description: A feedback drone: a plucked-string model fed only inaudible noise inside a loop that self-excites once the feedback passes the loop's losses, with a reverb in the loop and an echo after it

params.text: Sets the length of the string as a pitch, MIDI note 16 to 72
Sets the gain round the feedback loop, -60dB at the bottom of its travel to +12dB at the top; the drone wakes around unity
Sets a short delay in the loop, 1ms to 100ms: short gives a comb-coloured resonance and long a slow pulsing swell
Sets the corner of the low-pass inside the loop, 100Hz to 18000Hz, which steers which partials the feedback favours
Sets the corner of the high-pass inside the loop, 10Hz to 4000Hz, which steers which partials the feedback favours
Sets how much reverb is mixed in, and the reverb is inside the loop so the wet signal feeds back too
Sets how long the reverb tail rings, inside the loop
Sets how much of the loop is sent to the tape echo
Sets the echo delay, 50ms to 5 seconds
Sets the echo feedback, 0 to 1.5; past 1 the repeats grow until the soft clipper catches them
Halves the echo time at once for a doppler warp, and doubles it back when switched off

inputs.text: A signal injected into the feedback loop, for the string to chew on
Added to the pitch knob, one volt per octave
Added to the feedback knob, 7.2dB per volt
Added to the loop low-pass cutoff, one volt per octave
Added to the echo time, one volt per octave, with a positive voltage shortening it
Added to the body knob, a tenth of its travel per volt

outputs.text: The left side of the loop
The right side of the loop, whose body delay is four samples shorter than the left, which is what makes the image wide

notes: nothing sounds until the feedback knob rises past the loop's losses. With it at the bottom the module is silent however hard it is driven.
no oscillator generates the tone. The string is fed a constant stream of white noise at -90dBFS and the loop builds a tone out of it.
with Fast body CV off, an oscillator on the body jack bends the drone like tape wow and does nothing at all past a few hertz; with it on, the same modulation throws sidebands off the drone.
menu: Fast body CV — shortens the two glides on the body delay to about a millisecond each and recomputes the delay length every sample, but only while a cable is in the body jack

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.4: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only
